# MisTShaders

A Minecraft shader pack by **GamesofDev** and **GlacierDevelopment**.

## Features

- Custom lighting with sun color cycles (sunrise, noon, sunset, night)
- Shadow mapping with PCF filtering
- Bloom effect
- Underwater turbulence and lighting
- Tone mapping (ACES, CE, Filmic, Unreal, Reinhard)

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.12+
- OptiFine / Iris
